key_insight: Neuro-VL is a specialized vision-language model that interprets complete neuroimaging examinations and discusses findings in natural language.
clinical_relevance: Its reported capabilities could support radiology reporting and assessment of disease progression, but do not establish readiness for clinical deployment.
method: Trained on nearly one million neuroimaging studies from routine clinical care.
Evaluated abnormality diagnosis, localization, description and comprehensive report generation.
Compared serial examinations and tested resistance to misleading clinical assumptions.
evidence_signal: Across internal and international datasets, the abstract reports stronger performance than general-purpose and specialized medical models, without providing numerical results.
watch_item: Prospective clinical validation is needed to establish safety and reliability before routine use.
paper_title: A frontier machine intelligence for human neuroimaging
